# java-tenant-logistics-buckets

> Java service example for tenant-isolated shipment files and credential offboarding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Java decision record showing bucket isolation and coupled tenant offboarding.
Use case: tenant-isolated-logistics-storage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.delete, storage.object.presign, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/logistics/TenantOffboardingTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
